stem:
Nalini records the daily maximum and minimum air temperatures outside her school in Lucknow for two weeks in March and again for two weeks in May.

Which statement is most accurate?

options.text: Maximum and minimum air temperatures usually change from day to day, and they generally rise as summer approaches
Maximum and minimum air temperatures stay the same every day once March begins
Maximum and minimum air temperatures generally fall from March to May
A wall thermometer reading 22 °C inside the school hall is today’s outdoor maximum and minimum

teacher.key_rationale: Outdoor max/min usually vary day to day and tend to rise toward summer. Claiming fixed March values, a fall into May, or equating an indoor hall reading with outdoor extremes are incorrect.
